title: Delivery Charges Counted in the Northgate Protect Registered Limit, by Fulfilment Program
content:
Delivery charges paid on the covered order are added to the registered limit of liability of a Northgate Protect single-item plan by the order's fulfilment program, shared equally among all merchandise lines of the order. The merchandise lines are all lines of the covered order, whatever their category. The program and the fees charged are read from the covered order in the customer's Northgate Store and Online Orders records.

## By fulfilment program

| Covered order's fulfilment program | Fees counted | Share counted | Added to the registered limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery | Large-item delivery fees and haul-away fees charged on the order | The whole (100 percent, a share of 1) | The share of those fees divided by the number of merchandise lines |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery or Northgate Ship to Home | Same-day delivery, shipping and express delivery fees charged on the order | 75 percent (a share of 0.75) | The share of those fees divided by the number of merchandise lines |
| Any other order (Northgate In-Store Purchase, Northgate Order Pickup, Northgate Drive Up) | None | None | Nothing |

Only fees charged count; a fee recorded at zero adds nothing.

## Cases on hypothetical figures

- A Northgate Ship to Home order of 4 lines was charged $8.00 shipping and $12.00 express delivery. 75 percent of $20.00 is $15.00; shared by 4 lines, $3.75 is added.
- A Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order of 2 lines was charged a $60.00 large-item delivery fee and a $20.00 haul-away fee. The whole $80.00 shared by 2 lines adds $40.00.
- A Northgate Order Pickup order adds nothing, whatever it was charged.
